kind: synthetic negative
source: false_positive_finished_background.txt with a live spinner row added.
        The three lines it is built from are the harvested ones; their
        co-occurrence is the invented part, and it is invented on purpose.
why: `sidecar.finished_background_tasks_idle` (96) outranks `spinner_working`
     (90), and it is gated on Cursor's empty-composer placeholder because a
     live turn is not believed to render one. This fixture is what happens if
     that belief is ever wrong: without the rule's `not` gate the pane would
     report an *explicit* visible idle with the spinner still turning, and the
     tracker would announce a completed turn. With the gate the screen falls to
     upstream's `background_task_status_working`, which is working — the
     direction that costs nothing when it is wrong. This fixture must never
     resolve through a `sidecar.` rule.

state: working
